name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global composite PMI 53.2 in October, down from 54.3 but above the 51 Watch line; November flashes not out yet
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, its first decline in seven months, as growth eased amid heightened economic uncertainty (S&P Global, 5 Nov). The reading remains well above the 51 Watch line. November flash PMIs for major economies had not been published as of 19 Nov.
for_you: Global business activity is still growing, though more slowly. A sustained slowdown would tend to show up first in manufacturing orders, trade volumes and hiring.
